package rulefixtures

import (
	"github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
	"gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for repository_accepts_gin_context: Repositories that accept `*gin.Context` rather than `context.Context`.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: warning.

type Account struct {
	ID    uint   `gorm:"primaryKey"`
	Name  string `gorm:"size:128"`
	Email string `gorm:"size:256"`
}

type AccountRepo struct {
	db *gorm.DB
}

func NewAccountRepo(db *gorm.DB) *AccountRepo {
	return &AccountRepo{db: db}
}

func (r *AccountRepo) FindByID(c *gin.Context, id uint) (*Account, error) {
	var account Account
	err := r.db.WithContext(c.Request.Context()).First(&account, id).Error
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &account, nil
}

func (r *AccountRepo) Create(c *gin.Context, account *Account) error {
	return r.db.WithContext(c.Request.Context()).Create(account).Error
}

var _ = gorm.ErrRecordNotFound
